leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a custom service to manage localStorage operations in Angular
Configure dependency injection to provide the localStorage service throughout the application
Initialize component state by retrieving data from localStorage on application load
Manipulate localStorage data through service methods for setting, getting, and removing items
Bind component properties to localStorage values to maintain state persistence
Update localStorage synchronously when component data changes
Integrate localStorage service with Angular components to create persistent user interfaces
